title: Welcome to the UCDS Rebuild!
summary: We are excited to launch the brand-new React and Firebase rebuild of the University of Calgary Debate Society website.
content:
Welcome to our brand-new website! We have successfully migrated the UCDS codebase to React and integrated Google Firebase for dynamic database capabilities, and Python for automated background triggers.

This new setup ensures high-speed page loads, responsive navigation on both desktop and mobile, and a state-of-the-art secure executive panel.

title: Calgary Summer Cup 2026 Preparations
summary: Preparations are underway for the Calgary Summer Cup 2026, featuring various divisions for grades 6-12.
content:
We are gearing up for the Calgary Summer Cup 2026! The tournament will take place online on Discord on July 25th and 26th.

Registration is now open on the website. E-transfer payments can be sent directly to ucds.debate@gmail.com. We welcome debaters of all experience levels to sign up!
